destination.name: Taree
destination.tagline: A Manning River service town on the Pacific Highway, with surf beaches and roadside giants nearby.
destination.description: Taree is a large service town on the Manning River, bypassed by a freeway section of the Pacific Highway, and Wikivoyage calls it a reasonable stop on the drive rather than a major tourist destination. Visitors come for the Big Oyster and the Big Axe at Kew, for Crowdy Bay National Park's headland lookouts and dune walks, and for Old Bar, a surf village 18 km away on the coast. The area is known for its oysters.
whyVisit: Surf or stroll at Old Bar

goodToKnow.title: Stops on the main line
goodToKnow.detail: Taree station, ten minutes' walk from the centre, is on the Sydney to Brisbane line, and Flixbus and Greyhound also stop here.

goodToKnow.title: Old Bar is a drive away
goodToKnow.detail: The beach is 18 km from town, with a 2.5 km path to Wallabi Point, and is patrolled in summer.

goodToKnow.title: Oysters need a booking
goodToKnow.detail: The one farm tour listed, on Mitchells Island, is by appointment only; few places in town serve local oysters.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Old Bar's patrolled beach season and the coast's warm water make {months} the best time to visit.
